archetypes.name: drafter-launcher-parity
archetypes.rationale: New codex drafter must stay aligned with launch-claude-drafter.sh and the /implement codex launcher stack; drift in status KV, dirty-tree sidecar, or sentinel parsing would break Step 2b dispatch.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare scripts/launch-codex-drafter.sh against scripts/launch-claude-drafter.sh and the /implement codex exec path for argv shape, status KV fields, sidecar semantics, sentinel LARCH_PLAN_BEGIN/END parsing, and error exit codes. Flag any behavioral or contract drift that would make skills/design/SKILL.md Step 2b treat the two vendors differently than documented in SECURITY.md and launch-codex-drafter.md. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: drafter-vendor-routing
archetypes.rationale: Default drafter flips from Claude to Codex via LARCH_DESIGN_DRAFTER and CODEX_PRESENT gating; mis-routing or silent fallback could draft plans with the wrong vendor or skip subprocess unexpectedly.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review skills/design/SKILL.md Step 2b vendor selection, invalid-vendor skip reasons, append-tool-failure logging, dirty-tree recovery gates, and docs/configuration-and-permissions.md LARCH_DESIGN_DRAFTER versus LARCH_DESIGN_PLAN_MODEL scope. Verify defaults, explicit overrides, Codex-unavailable degradation to Claude, and inline fallback paths cannot leave stale plan artifacts or proceed after confirmed baseline-delta mutations. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: codex-drafter-harness-gap
archetypes.rationale: launch-codex-drafter.md admits no offline harness while claude drafter has test-launch-claude-drafter.sh; shared parser logic may regress without mirrored coverage.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine test coverage for the new codex drafter path: agent-lint.toml exclusions, launch-codex-drafter.md harness notes, and whether the inline Python sentinel parser in launch-codex-drafter.sh is exercised only via the claude harness. Identify untested failure branches such as CODEX_EXEC_FAILED, CODEX_EMPTY_OUTPUT, DELIMITER_EXTRACTION_INVALID, and baseline-porcelain dirty-tree modes that could ship without regression detection. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
